metadata.title: The symmetric Gaussian isoperimetric problem in the plane
metadata.abstract: We resolve the symmetric Gaussian isoperimetric conjecture in the plane: every minimizer of Gaussian perimeter among centrally symmetric sets of prescribed Gaussian measure is a centered ball, a symmetric strip, or the complement of one of these sets. A quadrant-reflection argument reduces the problem to unconditional sets. The planar structural results of Barchiesi, Cagnetti and Julin then leave only a noncircular strictly convex stationary oval. We exclude this oval by an explicit volume-preserving and perimeter-decreasing linear deformation, which geometrically corresponds to an "unconditional squeezing". More generally, without requiring any symmetry assumptions, we show that any noncircular closed embedded $\lambda$-self-shrinker is always unstable via linear deformations. We also record a reduction to the unconditional case in dimension three, using an orthogonal equipartition theorem of Musin.

analysis.progressType: 平面对称Gaussian等周问题的极小形状分类
analysis.workSummary: 作者解决平面中心对称Gaussian等周猜想：给定Gaussian测度的中心对称集合，Gaussian周长极小者只能是中心球、对称条带或其补集。先用象限反射化为unconditional集合，再结合Barchiesi–Cagnetti–Julin结构结果，只剩非圆严格凸驻定卵形，以保体积降周长线性形变排除。
techniques: 保体积线性不稳定变分
analysis.breakthrough: 不加对称假设时也证明非圆闭嵌入λ-self-shrinker在线性形变下不稳定；三维另用Musin正交等分定理归约到unconditional类。
analysis.limitations: 完整极小形状分类是在平面；三维只给归约，不等于解决三维猜想。驻定不等于极小，不稳定结论需保留闭、嵌入和非圆。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: PDF第3页AI Declaration详述贡献链：AI完成用Musin定理的三维归约；平面不稳定性最初尝试未果，作者提出线性形变后得到S<0充分条件，再由作者提示Poincaré不等式后，AI证明Key Inequality并完成论证；AI还起草初稿，作者修改完善并负责。确定记proofs/writing；线性形变与Poincaré核心路线明确是作者提出，不归给AI。三维扩展虽有具体证明贡献，声明未清楚单独归因其概念性路线发现，故不另推ideas。未具名模型。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12456v1 · PDF 第3页 AI Declaration
